crossRefs.note: As he said these things to them, the scribes and the Pharisees began to be terribly angry, and to draw many things out…
lying in wait for him, and seeking to catch him in something he might say, that they might accuse him.
They watched him and sent out spies, who pretended to be righteous, that they might trap him in something he said, so…

people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: The high priest therefore asked Jesus about his disciples and about his teaching.
translations.bsb: Meanwhile, the high priest questioned Jesus about His disciples and His teaching.
translations.kjv: The high priest then asked Jesus of his disciples, and of his doctrine.
translations.asv: The high priest therefore asked Jesus of his disciples, and of his teaching.
